name: AutoFix
description: Automatically sanitizes messy release titles, resolves missing TMDb metadata, injects posters, and cleans movie and subtitle filenames in-place.
overview: Permanently eliminates blank grey boxes in Jellyfin by pre-cleaning messy release names, resolving TMDb IDs, injecting artwork, and cleanly renaming media and subtitle files on disk using confirmed Jellyfin metadata.

versions.changelog: v1.0.4: Clean build without conflicting host assemblies. In-place renames movies and subtitles directly from confirmed Jellyfin metadata. Zero file deletions.
